items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 3 at 8:36AM AKST until November 6 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow and blowing snow expected. Total snow accumulations up
to two inches. Winds gusting as high as 35 to 50 mph.

* WHERE...Central Beaufort Sea Coast, Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast, and
Northern Arctic Coast.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 3 PM AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Areas of blowing snow could
reduce visibility below one half mile. Blizzard conditions will be
possible dependent on the severity of blowing snow.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 3 at 7:58AM AKST until November 4 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 45 mph with gusts up to 65 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 6 AM to 6 PM AKST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 3 at 1:50AM AKST until November 4 at 6:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations up to 5 inches.

* WHERE...The Klondike Highway, including White Pass

* WHEN...From 6 PM this evening to 6 AM AKST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. Conditions will likely
become slick and hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snow levels are expected to be around 1800
feet. This will limit snow accumulations for places below milepost
10 on the Klondike Highway.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions where available call 511 or visit 511.alaska.gov.
